tayantPay.note: Manually-maintained ledger; transaction count is an estimate from raw row counts, not a formula in the sheet. Fees rose from K237.90 to K570.90 since the last check (31 Aug) as more entries were logged. The block runs a few days into September before the next reset/carry-forward line, so this snapshot includes a handful of early-September rows too. The Russia-leg columns are kept in a mix of rubles and Kwacha-equivalent figures in the source sheet, so treat the closing balance as Zambia (Kwacha) only.
